advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Take Care of Your People & Staff
advice_items.quote: You take care of your people, you're going to be successful.
advice_items.summary_en: Take care of your employees and avoid corporate homogenization that neglects the staff.
advice_items.summary_zh: 善待员工，别让大公司同质化企业文化

advice_items.quote: I always tried to have three sources of income, three different businesses in different categories working to make money.
advice_items.summary_en: Diversify across three separate businesses in different industries rather than putting all eggs in one basket.
advice_items.summary_zh: 布局三个不同领域的收入来源分散风险

advice_items.canonical_tag: Be Careful Who You Partner With
advice_items.quote: If your partners can't make the call... If you can't make that call, they don't need to be your partner.
advice_items.summary_en: Only partner with people who can step up and put in capital when the business needs cash flow.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谨慎选择合伙人，必须能共同承担追加出资

advice_items.quote: I literally walked into a bank on Saturday and met with the president of the bank on the day he was off and got a loan for $550,000 and opened my first business.
advice_items.summary_en: Don't be afraid to take bold initiative and leverage business debt to launch your venture.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不要害怕创业负债，果断抓住融资机会

guests.first_money_or_break: 在农场长大，周六直接找休假中的银行行长贷到55万美元创办首家企业，后经营电视台、餐厅和农场并在公司被收购时赚取丰厚回报。
guests.wealth_detail: TV stations $30M-$40M/yr revenue, restaurant $5M/yr revenue; multiple 8-figure earner

advice_items.canonical_tag: Use Debt Wisely (Good Debt vs Bad Debt)
advice_items.quote: If you don't learn how to leverage debt, you'll always be working for somebody else who knows how to leverage debt.
advice_items.summary_en: Leverage other people's money to buy real estate or start cash-flowing businesses instead of merely trying to pay off debt.
advice_items.summary_zh: 学会借用他人资金与杠杆，投资生息资产

advice_items.quote: Starting a business is hard... Well, it's hard being broke... So, you got to choose what hard you want.
advice_items.summary_en: Building a business is hard, but staying broke year after year is also hard—choose which hard you want.
advice_items.summary_zh: 创业难、穷困也难，选择你愿意承担的困难

guests.first_money_or_break: 幼年丧父、母亲曾入狱，大学读了90天便辍学且曾身无分文，后创办数字营销公司并投资，27岁成为百万富翁。

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Treat Yourself as a Business & Brand
advice_items.quote: This is a business. You got to look at as a business. You're a business. You're your own commodity... I am my brand.
advice_items.summary_en: Prioritize business over trying to make friends or please everyone, and view yourself as your own brand and commodity.
advice_items.summary_zh: 把自己当作独立品牌与生意来经营

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Don't Give Competitors Ammunition Against You
advice_items.quote: Just always imagine that everybody's pointing a gun at your head... It's up to you how many bullets you give them.
advice_items.summary_en: Stay guarded and avoid giving others unnecessary ammunition or leverage they can use against you.
advice_items.summary_zh: 谨慎言行，不要给对手留下攻击你的把柄

advice_items.canonical_tag: Live Below Your Means & Avoid Lifestyle Creep
advice_items.quote: Always live beneath your means... I don't need a Bugatti. I'm not paying $3 $5 million for a car cuz I don't need one.
advice_items.summary_en: Live below your means and keep cash in the bank instead of buying extravagant wants after losing everything once to foreclosure.
advice_items.summary_zh: 始终量入为出，避免为不需要的奢侈品挥霍

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Do Business Pragmatically Beyond Personal Feelings
advice_items.quote: I can do business with people I don't necessarily like... people will do business with you if you can generate money for them.
advice_items.summary_en: Separate personal feelings from work and be willing to do business with people you dislike when there is mutual financial value.
advice_items.summary_zh: 以商业利益为重，能与不喜欢但互利的人合作

guests.first_money_or_break: 由单亲妈妈在华盛顿特区贫困街区抚养长大，曾一度买不起食物，30多岁进入职业摔角界才开始赚钱，后破产并转战好莱坞影视业重获成功。
guests.role_or_title: Hollywood Actor & Former WWE Professional Wrestler

advice_items.canonical_tag: Own Equity Rather Than Trading Time
advice_items.quote: Poor people and middle-class people... pay for everything with money they've exchanged their time for... wealthy creative entrepreneurs... create an offer to pay for everything we buy.
advice_items.summary_en: Stop paying for life by trading time for money; instead, use creativity to craft offers that fund what you want.
advice_items.summary_zh: 别用时间换钱，要用创造力设计方案来创收

advice_items.quote: Every success principle that I learned, the very first thing that I do is I go back and look at scripture and see if it lines up. If it does, I'll follow it.
advice_items.summary_en: Put faith first and evaluate every success principle against scripture before following it.
advice_items.summary_zh: 以信仰和经文原则作为筛选成功法则的准则

guests.first_money_or_break: 早年贫困，赚到数百万美元后曾再度破产，重建后通过商业咨询打造出稳定财富体系，单年最高收入达1500万美元。
